name: Arturi Radanavich
biography:
A quiet, soft-spoken Vistana in his late thirties with a distant, almost absent-minded countenance and a near-painful sincerity. He carries five daggers and wears studded leather armor.

Beacon of Protection: While Argynvost's beacon shines, Arturi opposes Strahd, and he remains in Barovia, he gains +1 AC and saving throws. Apply this bonus manually.

items.name: Dagger
items.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

items.name: Multiattack
items.description: Arturi makes two attacks with his dagger.

items.name: Parry
items.description: When Arturi is hit by a melee attack while wielding a weapon, he adds 2 to his AC against that attack, potentially causing it to miss. Apply this bonus manually.
